text:
rachel_pm: Quick sync — we need to lock the packaging/upgrade approach for Private (VPC/on-prem) by EOW. Field asks keep pushing modular installers + safer upgrade paths.
kevin_eng: Agreed. Proposal: split into three artifacts: control-plane package, data-plane runtime, and a networking connector. Makes upgrades isolated.
sarah_pd: +1 on modularity. Customer asks: minimal downtime for upgrades, clear rollback, and ability to pin kernel/quantization profiles.
jordan_netops: From netops POV we need deterministic egress IPs or a well-documented peering mode. Customers with strict firewall rules can't handle random NAT ports.
leo_ops: Also need a healthcheck-driven orchestrator for rolling upgrades; if a node fails, auto-roll back. That reduces manual SRE effort.
rachel_pm: Good. Tradeoffs: modularity increases orchestration complexity and customer config surface. We should prioritize a sane default config that works for 90% of customers.
kevin_eng: For upgrades: support two strategies out-of-box: rolling (preferred) and blue/green for customers with LB/peering support. Rolling must preserve KV cache compatibility across minor model/version bumps.
sarah_pd: Launch criteria suggestion: (1) automated installer for linux distros + container mode, (2) rollback via artifact pinning, (3) network quickstart for static IP and VPC-peering, (4) field pilot with 3 customers.
jordan_netops: Add: clear docs for IP preservation during upgrade and a small script to reconcile firewall rules. Also an option for customers to supply an external NAT gateway.
leo_ops: Will prototype a healthcheck orchestrator + a simple CLI to schedule rolling upgrades. ETA: 3 sprints for alpha.
kevin_eng: Implementation notes: packages signed, semver for packages + model images, migration hooks defined as JSON schema: 
```
{"migration_version":"2.1","pre_hooks":["drain_kv_cache"],"post_hooks":["validate_routes","smoke_infer"]}
```
we need to land this schema before code.
rachel_pm: Good pattern. Who owns the schema spec? @kevin_eng?
kevin_eng: I can own it, will draft spec by Tue.
sarah_pd: Prioritization: customers with regulatory constraints (finance, health) get top priority for field pilots. Others on waitlist.
jordan_netops: We should also decide defaults for customer-managed networking: expose three modes — static-egress, vpc-peering, and managed-proxy. Document expected limits for each.
leo_ops: For rollback: we need quick snapshot + revert script. If we can snapshot KV and config pre-upgrade in <30s, that's a strong guarantee.
rachel_pm: Action items: kevin -> draft migration schema & packaging split doc; leo -> prototype orchestrator and snapshot script; jordan -> network quickstart and firewall reconcile script; sarah -> candidate pilot customers list + success criteria.
kevin_eng: I'll put a PR up with schema and package layout by Tue EOD.
sarah_pd: I'll email legal/compliance for pilot approvals and start outreach.
leo_ops: I'll wire up a demo in staging this week.
deploy-bot: deploy scheduled: staging/private-packaging-alpha to env:staging at 2024-05-02T18:30:00Z.
rachel_pm: Thanks team — let's checkpoint Wed morning, 30m. If anything blocks the schema deadline ping here. :thumbsup:
